key: I hear the city is making plans to take another shot at cleaning the Wasteland.
en: I hear the city is making plans to take another shot at cleaning the Wasteland.
ja: 市がまた荒地の浄化に取り組む計画を立てているらしい。

key: Impossible, I would say.
en: Impossible, I would say.
ja: 無理だろうね。

key: But I would have said the same for this city itself.
en: But I would have said the same for this city itself.
ja: でも、この街自体についても同じことを言っていただろう。

key: There may be hope yet.
en: There may be hope yet.
ja: まだ望みはあるのかもしれない。

key: Salon de Glamazonia
en: Salon de Glamazonia
ja: グラマゾニア美容室

key: Well, can't say I ever imagined living in a place like this.
en: Well, can't say I ever imagined living in a place like this.
ja: こんな場所に住むことになるとは思ってもみなかったよ。

key: Gotta say it's almost too good to be true.
en: Gotta say it's almost too good to be true.
ja: 正直、できすぎなくらいだよ。

key: > - Lilycove Street\n^ - 10th Street
en: > - Lilycove Street\n^ - 10th Street
ja: > - ミナモ通り\n^ - 10番通り

en: > - Jubilife Street\n^v - 10th Street
ja: > - トバリ通り\n^v - 10番通り

key: ???: Excuse me! Do you have a moment to spare for the sake of this beautiful planet?
en: ???: Excuse me! Do you have a moment to spare for the sake of this beautiful planet?
ja: ???: すみません! この美しい星のために少しお時間をいただけますか?

key: ???: Thank you for caring about the world we live in!
en: ???: Thank you for caring about the world we live in!
ja: ???: わたしたちが暮らすこの世界を気にかけてくださってありがとうございます!

key: The truth is, despite every single one of us being dependent on this planet, many people just don't give it the time of day!
en: The truth is, despite every single one of us being dependent on this planet, many people just don't give it the time of day!
ja: 実を言うと、誰もがこの星に頼って生きているというのに、多くの人はまるで気にも留めていないんです!

key: Reborn has definitely come a long way, but the thoughtlessness that led to its decline before is still alive and well!
en: Reborn has definitely come a long way, but the thoughtlessness that led to its decline before is still alive and well!
ja: リボーンは確かに大きく変わりました。でも、かつて衰退を招いたあの無頓着さは今も健在なんです!

key: Every day the environment is harmed further, many innocent and sweet Pokémon are losing their homes!
en: Every day the environment is harmed further, many innocent and sweet Pokémon are losing their homes!
ja: 毎日、環境はさらに傷つけられ、罪のないかわいいポケモンたちが住処を失っているんです!

key: Did you know that every year over 10,000 Wingull are caught in landfills that aren't properly contained?
en: Did you know that every year over 10,000 Wingull are caught in landfills that aren't properly contained?
ja: ご存じですか? 毎年1万匹以上のキャモメが、管理の行き届いていない埋立地に巻き込まれているんですよ。

key: And every MONTH there are thousands of Water Pokémon in seas all across the world dying because of underwater pollution?
en: And every MONTH there are thousands of Water Pokémon in seas all across the world dying because of underwater pollution?
ja: しかも毎月、世界中の海で水質汚染によって何千匹ものみずタイプポケモンが命を落としているんです。

key: My goal is to change that!
en: My goal is to change that!
ja: わたしの目標は、それを変えることです!

key: Your support can go a long way to making tomorrow a little brighter!
en: Your support can go a long way to making tomorrow a little brighter!
ja: あなたの支援が、明日を少しだけ明るくする力になります!

key: So, would you be willing to sign this petition to make the city board acknowledge the still-lingering threat of environmental detractors in Reborn?
en: So, would you be willing to sign this petition to make the city board acknowledge the still-lingering threat of environmental detractors in Reborn?
ja: そこで、リボーンに今もくすぶる環境破壊の脅威を市議会に認めさせるための、この署名にご協力いただけませんか?

key: ... Is what I'd like to say, but...
en: ... Is what I'd like to say, but...
ja: ……と言いたいところなんですけど……

key: The truth is, we already got plenty of signatures during the restoration,
en: The truth is, we already got plenty of signatures during the restoration,
ja: 実は、復興のときにもう十分な署名は集まったんです。

key: But the city still hasn't acted appropriately in response.
en: But the city still hasn't acted appropriately in response.
ja: なのに、市はいまだにきちんと対応してくれなくて。

key: And now, everyone's so caught up in how great the city looks now that they're forgetting everything that's slipping through the cracks!
en: And now, everyone's so caught up in how great the city looks now that they're forgetting everything that's slipping through the cracks!
ja: それに今じゃ、みんな街が良くなったことに浮かれちゃって、こぼれ落ちてることに気づきもしないんです!

key: To be honest, I'm getting kind of desperate here...
en: To be honest, I'm getting kind of desperate here...
ja: 正直、ちょっと切羽詰まってて……

key: Ummm, hey?
en: Ummm, hey?
ja: あの、ちょっと……

key: I'm thinking about taking matters into my own hands...
en: I'm thinking about taking matters into my own hands...
ja: 自分の手でなんとかしようかなって思ってて……

key: Would you be willing to back me up?
en: Would you be willing to back me up?
ja: 力を貸してもらえませんか?

key: ???: Really?
en: ???: Really?
ja: ???: 本当ですか?

key: Mm... Okay, we can do this!
en: Mm... Okay, we can do this!
ja: うん……よし、これならやれる!

key: Let's fight for the planet!
en: Let's fight for the planet!
ja: この星のために戦いましょう!

key: By the way, my name's Sandy! And you are...?
en: By the way, my name's Sandy! And you are...?
ja: そういえば、わたしの名前はサンディ! あなたは……?

key: \PN? It's a pleasure to meet you!
en: \PN? It's a pleasure to meet you!
ja: \PN? はじめまして!

key: So, let's talk about our first mission...
en: So, let's talk about our first mission...
ja: さて、最初のミッションについて話しましょう……

key: This restoration has been a huge improvement for the region overall, but there's one part of Reborn that's suffering as a result...
en: This restoration has been a huge improvement for the region overall, but there's one part of Reborn that's suffering as a result...
ja: この復興は地方全体にとって大きな改善になりました。でも、そのせいで苦しんでいるリボーンの一角があるんです……

key: Malchous Forest!
en: Malchous Forest!
ja: マルコウスの森!

key: The deforestation of Malchous has been causing more and more Pokémon to lose their precious homes...
en: The deforestation of Malchous has been causing more and more Pokémon to lose their precious homes...
ja: マルコウスの森林伐採のせいで、大切な住処を失うポケモンがどんどん増えているんです……

key: I just can't stand by while that happens!
en: I just can't stand by while that happens!
ja: それを黙って見ていることなんてできません!

key: Meet me at Malchous Forest Park and let's put a stop to it!
en: Meet me at Malchous Forest Park and let's put a stop to it!
ja: マルコウス森林公園で待ち合わせて、これを止めましょう!

key: Oh, that's okay, I understand.
en: Oh, that's okay, I understand.
ja: ああ、大丈夫です、わかります。

key: This could get messy anyway...
en: This could get messy anyway...
ja: どのみちややこしいことになりそうですし……
???: そ、そうですか。

key: Um, all right. Have a nice day, I guess!
en: Um, all right. Have a nice day, I guess!
ja: えっと、わかりました。それじゃ、良い一日を!

key: ???: Oh, hi again...
en: ???: Oh, hi again...
ja: ???: あ、また会いましたね……

key: I don't suppose... you changed your mind about helping me?
en: I don't suppose... you changed your mind about helping me?
ja: もしかして……手伝ってくれる気になりました?

key: Meet me at Malchous Forest and let's put a stop to it!
en: Meet me at Malchous Forest and let's put a stop to it!
ja: マルコウスの森で待ち合わせて、これを止めましょう!

ja: サンディ: あ、あなたですね!

key: Remember me?
en: Remember me?
ja: 覚えてます?

key: Hey, actually, do you have a moment?
en: Hey, actually, do you have a moment?
ja: ねえ、実はちょっと時間ありますか?

key: I'd like to talk to you about some very serious matters regarding the future of this beautiful planet!
en: I'd like to talk to you about some very serious matters regarding the future of this beautiful planet!
ja: この美しい星の未来に関わる、とても大事な話があるんです!

key: SANDY: Thank you for caring about the world we live in!
en: SANDY: Thank you for caring about the world we live in!
ja: サンディ: わたしたちが暮らすこの世界を気にかけてくれてありがとう!

en: SANDY: Oh, hi again...
